repository_purpose: A pure agent meta-skill that distributes skills, agents, and prompts by typed reference instead of copying assets into every repo or device.

runtime: private Git or local path access

findings: The-library is explicitly a catalog of references, not a copy-first registry, which matches the parent requirement to preserve packet boundaries until compile time.
The upstream skill is agent-agnostic and names Pi as a supported harness, which makes it a better parent-native distribution authority than any single-vendor plugin system.
The shipped `library.yaml` is intentionally empty, so the parent wrapper must provide its own governed entries and validation instead of assuming upstream defaults.

capability_rows.upstream_feature_name: typed reference catalog for skills, agents, and prompts
capability_rows.validation_method: Validate that parent library entries resolve to typed references, preserve source-of-truth locations, and distribute on demand without repo-tree mirroring.
capability_rows.blocker_or_dependency: Requires private Git or local-path access to the referenced artifacts and a governed catalog inside the parent wrapper.

trigger_logic: Resolve library entries when a peer joins or when the parent registry is refreshed.

actor_logic: The peer mesh host admits governed assets after reference validation, not by blind sync.
Library distribution stays catalog-driven and private-first across devices and teams.
validation_summary: Require every distributed unit to name its type and source path/URL.
Reject copy-first workflows as the default parent behavior.

blockers: No exact blocker for the parent contract layer; the only gating boundary is source accessibility for private references.
